recipePolicy.rule: Only enum-constrained primitive, relation, operation, trigger and track discriminators are structural. Free semantic labels and content payloads are non-structural and MUST NOT be read by resolver or renderer as layout selectors.

semanticInvariants: Every graphId is unique within its declared graphId domain.
Every graphId reference resolves to the required domain; sourceId values are never resolved as graphId values.
Every node.assetRef and setAsset/replaceAsset reference resolves to assetManifest.assets.id.
Only repeat nodes may contain dataBinding; every repeat node has dataBinding and its sourceContentRef resolves to a data content atom.
Every scene, relation, node, state, timeline, track and viewport-profile reference resolves.
Motion keyframe offsets are strictly ascending and include offsets 0 and 1.
viewportProgress.startProgress is strictly less than endProgress.
motionCoordination.orderedTrackIds contains exactly the timeline track ids once each.
replaceTimeline reduced-motion policy requires replacementTimelineId; other policies forbid it.
responsive profile ids and priorities are unique; equal-priority matching profiles are an error.
responsive.baseProfileId resolves to a declared profile.
editorMutationBatch hashes and revisions form one forward chain and every operation is reversible from its typed before payload.
resolvedSceneGraph, lockedBlueprint and renderManifest generationId and sha256 references form one unbroken chain.
